selection_rule: Maximize validation target macro-F1 across two target classes, including negative-frame FP. CNN epochs selected on validation with synthetic validation guard; no new test used.
notes: Roles/manual labels frozen first. Previously observed phase-3 test sources are development. Do not modify pipeline after reading new test results. The real test photos were already opened in phase 4; their phase-4 summary scores were known while phase-5 bugs were fixed using synthetic probes and development/validation only. No test photo was run during phase-5 development, but the test is no longer an unseen benchmark.
